title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this game of team strike zone started.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Each person gets three pitches.
The team that knocks down the most panels wins.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My team will start things off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll do my best to not hold us back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Competition or no, it's only a game, so—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! Toya! Kamishiro!
Make Akito taste the bitterest of defeats!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems that we have a strong supporter.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There she goes again. Has Ena forgotten who we're here for exactly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! That's just Ena being Ena, so I just think it's fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, we will just have to see what they can do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: His focus is incredible...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But isn't Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hup!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh...?! The ball disappeared?!
Did he throw it that fast...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
N-No...
It fell out of his hand right as he was about to release it. Look, it's rolling behind him.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Two hits on the very last pitch?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seven in total.
We're gonna have to buckle down if we want to win.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to show them what real teamwork is about!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Boooo.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You call that booing?
That's not gonna be enough to break my concentration... Look!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Fire!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! I totally thought I got two at once right there! I hit panels one and four, didn't I...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it seems like you just barely hit the outer frame to the left of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! No way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There!
Noooo...! But I already hit panel two!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're down to your last pitch. Even if you get one more, you'll only tie us at seven, so we won't lose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I am not about to have our birthday star buy drinks!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Akito, Tsukasa & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you all for buying.
Thank you all for buying!
Thank you all for buying♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Who would've guessed that he'd knock down two panels at the end there like you did, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It felt like something out of a TV drama.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel kinda bad. You even bought drinks for us too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, it's a small token of our appreciation for all the cheering you did.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there you guys are!
Sorry we're so late, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome, you two!
I heard you took a detour, but what happened?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We found something really wonderful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we did. And we know you're gonna love it, Mizuki. Ta-daa! An accessory with ribbons on it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa!
This is right up my alley!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we thought so! We had another candidate, but we're glad that we decided to go with this one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You seem happy, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do I?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You look really happy too, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's because Mizuki is smiling, laughing and having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you guys so much for hanging out with me today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm super happy because we got to try out that Print Sticker machine for big groups!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you again at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd really prefer outside of school.
se_walk_men_002_4
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, let's head back to the Print Sticker machines! I wanna take a pic with Miku and the others now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We can finally show our faces again.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I thought you guys went back to SEKAI to take a break. When did you get back?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <While you were all playing strike zone...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, we didn't get to see everything, but we were rooting for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you heard us talking about Print Stickers?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah... I am a little interested...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Let's commemorate this day by taking a picture together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa told us all about what you guys did at SpoJoy Park! We really wish that we could've gone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, we had work.
But we are glad that we were able to wish you a happy birthday in time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you'll let us make up for being a little late by celebrating just that much more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Again, Mizuki, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki!
Have you had a chance to watch the celebratory video we sent over to your phone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We performed a special version of that song of ours you said that you really like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We changed the choreography a little bit, so we hope you have fun finding what's different.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'd also love to hear what you think later. And we should go shopping together again sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki!
I'm so glad that I got to celebrate with you. I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the game of strike zone you guys played ended up being really close, right? I wish I got to see what happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Asahina and Tsukasa both hit two panels at once. Akiyama was also close but missed by a hair.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Another pitch might've resulted in a twofer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mizuki!
Happy-happy-happy-happy-happy-happy-happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu and I got you a present.
Would it be possible for us to meet up at school?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Mizuki is sure to come to school if you say you have a birthday present waiting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, when that time comes, we'll throw Akiyama a big celebration! We'll be waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
I'm so glad that you had fun at SpoJoy Park.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'll probably be aching all over soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because you don't get enough exercise in your day to day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I exercise a little. But who wouldn't be sore after all that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm...
It might be a good idea for us to take it easy tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, I got to do so much today!
I might be pretty sore tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But something odd's been happening...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The fun and joy I've been feeling lately seems a little different somehow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess that's what makes today feel so special!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!
